settings.title: Settings
settings.no_route_title: This instance has no web address
settings.no_route_description: This instance has no web route, for example after a clone. Set a new host name and save to publish it.
settings.public_service_description: PrivateBin has no login. Anyone who can reach the host name can create documents. Documents are encrypted in the browser: the server never sees their content.
settings.name: Service name
settings.name_helper: Shown in the browser title and the navigation bar
settings.notice_helper: Plain text shown above the editor, for example a usage policy. Leave empty to hide it.
settings.info_helper: Shown at the bottom of the page. HTML is allowed, for example a link to your terms. Leave empty to show the default text.
settings.logo_helper: PNG or JPEG, 512 KB at most. Shown 38 pixels high, a square image works best.
settings.logo_invalid_format: Choose a PNG or JPEG image
settings.logo_too_large: The image is larger than 512 KB
settings.expire_max_helper: Longer expirations are not offered to users
settings.expire_default_above_max: The default expiration cannot be longer than the longest expiration
settings.burn_after_reading_selected: Burn after reading checked by default
settings.burn_after_reading_selected_tooltip: The document is deleted after its first reading. Users can still uncheck it.
settings.qrcode: QR code of the document link
settings.file_upload_tooltip: Users can attach files. Images, PDF, audio and video files get a preview.
settings.size_limit_info_description: The limit applies to the encrypted document, text and attachments together. Encryption adds about one third to the file size. The upload must finish within 60 seconds, so large documents need a fast connection.
settings.language_selection_tooltip: Users can choose another language from the navigation bar
